description: JavaScript code providing enhancements for Drupal's managed file field type, including validation, auto-upload, progress bars, and file preview links.

methods.name: validateExtension
methods.description: Client-side validation of file extensions during file upload.

methods.name: triggerUploadButton
methods.description: Triggers the upload button to auto-upload a file.

methods.name: disableFields
methods.description: Temporarily disables other file input fields during upload to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: progressBar
methods.description: Adds a progress bar during file upload if supported.

methods.name: openInNewWindow
methods.description: Opens file links in a new browser window for preview.
